migration.note: 0.8.0 → 0.8.1, additive: attribute sources (CA-13) and link citations; a placeholder in a required attribute now fails sdem check (LC-04). 0.8.1 → 0.9.0: a platform's network is a link (RA4-37) — a network's `connects` list becomes those links; a hosting platform on no network is a warning (LC-15); trace and impact follow networks (KG-Q-08). 0.9.0 → 0.10.0: network zones — level 0 on premises or cloud, level 1 internal or DMZ, level 2 private — hold the shapes deployed in them (RA4-38); every shape in a zone (LC-16), the structure checked (LC-17), internet-facing shapes in a DMZ (LC-18); additive. 0.10.0 → 0.11.0: hosting — cloud first by default, on premises by evidence (metamodel/hosting-signals.json); sdem aid proposes each shape's zone, marked inferred, for a person to confirm; zone connections ZC-01…ZC-04; additive. 0.11.0 → 0.12.0: an A3 interface reached from the internet is EXPOSED_THROUGH an A4 edge platform (LC-22); sdem aid proposes it, and a connection for every A4 shape linked to nothing (AID-C01…C06), for a person to decide; additive. 0.12.0 → 0.13.0: a network zone is an ArchiMate Grouping, not a network — zones nest by RA4-39; a zone carrying a network's attributes is split into the zone and its network

breaking: sdem check reads TBD, unknown, /TBD or an empty string in a required attribute as missing: an error on an active record — leave the value out and mark the record planned (LC-04)
a change-set update merges by default; give "replace": true for the whole-record replacement (AG-K08)

the link type COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE (deprecated in 0.15.0, metamodel 0.8.0) is removed in metamodel 0.9.0: a component DEPLOYED_ON anything but a node, device or system software is refused — re-point or supersede it before upgrading (sdem check reports each one)

deprecations.do: record each platform's network as a link — platform association network (RA4-37); sdem migrate converts the list
place the platform the component is deployed on in its network zone (RA4-38), and link the platform to its network (RA4-37) — S37 reads that route first

actions.do: sdem migrate --workspace <dir> --person <you> --dry-run, then without --dry-run, for every workspace
regenerate them (sdem build, view, dashboard, home) — they now link to each other
record its network zones — on premises or cloud, internal and any DMZ, private networks inside internal — and place each shape (sdem check names every shape in no zone, LC-16)
choose its zones with sdem new --hosting cloud | on_premises | hybrid — or let sdem aid propose them from your organisation's default (profile hosting.default, PR-32)

releases.summary: Architect experience: Home, dashboard and graph linked; graph status shown; architect tasks; sdem new --explore; the README and the Payments walkthrough rewritten. Then the improvement roadmap (metamodel 0.8.1): placeholders are missing values, natural keys for operations, attribute and link sources, evidence classes, sdem change diff, sdem handback. A platform's network is a link, and a network change reaches what runs on it (metamodel 0.9.0); network zones say where every technology shape is deployed (metamodel 0.10.0); hosting is proposed from evidence and the organisation's default, and the zones' connections are SDEM's rules (metamodel 0.11.0).
